documents.text: Ada Lovelace collaborated with Charles Babbage. She wrote extensive notes about his Analytical Engine. Her notes included an algorithm for computing Bernoulli numbers, and she is often described as an early computer programmer.
Qdrant is a vector database and similarity search engine. It stores embedding vectors with payload metadata and supports filtered nearest-neighbor retrieval using cosine distance.
Neo4j is a graph database. It represents domain facts as nodes and directed relationships, enabling graph traversal queries across connected entities.
